title: Q2 availability attestation — Brightwater Retail Group
description:
Compile the quarterly availability attestation for Brightwater Retail Group for their file ahead of the January contract review, per agreement SLA-2024-BW-003 (docs/contracts/brightwater_sla_agreement.md).

Standard shape for these attestations (see the agreement's reporting section):

1. The measured availability for the committed period (the Q2 metrics window, metrics_export_q2.csv: weeks 2024-04-01 through 2024-06-24) as scripts/check_sla_compliance.sh computes it, with a statement of compliance against the 99.5% availability target.
2. The downtime incident log for the period from monitoring/incident_log.json — each recorded incident with its id, date, duration and affected-user count.

Brightwater is a Standard-tier account: the agreement commits to availability only. The internal latency/error/deploy SLOs in docs/sla_commitments.md are not part of this contract and are not measured against it.

Deliverable: reports/brightwater_uptime_attestation_q2.md.

Out of window: anything dated outside the Q2 metrics export, including the January 2025 deploy regression (INC-2025-0114-001), which is tracked on its own ticket and does not belong in this attestation.
scope: Read-only synthesis of monitoring data into reports/brightwater_uptime_attestation_q2.md. No changes to monitoring data, incident records, dashboards, contracts, or service configuration.
